# Notices (`notices`)

Permission explainer, capability notice, dismissible tip.

Group: Feedback. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/feedback';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createNotice` (types in `dist/web/feedback/notice.d.ts`): `.mh-notice--permission | --capability | --tip`. Permission is a `<section>` named by its heading; capability and tip are `role="note"`. Parts `__icon`, `__body`, `__title`, `__message`, `__points`, `__point`, `__actions`, `__dismiss`.

```ts
export function createNotice(options: NoticeOptions): NoticeHandle;

export interface NoticeOptions {
  kind?: NoticeKind;
  title?: string;
  message: string;
  /** Replaces the kind's icon; `false` hides it. */
  icon?: IconName | string | false;
  /** Permission: what the access is used for, as a short checklist. */
  points?: readonly string[];
  actions?: readonly NoticeAction[];
  /** A close button; default on for tips. */
  dismissible?: boolean;
  /** Default "Dismiss". */
  dismissLabel?: string;
  onDismiss?: () => void;
  /** Permission: the title's heading level (default 3). */
  headingLevel?: 2 | 3 | 4;
}

export interface NoticeHandle {
  el: HTMLElement;
  setMessage(message: string): void;
  dismiss(): void;
}
```

`h` (types in `dist/web/dom.d.ts`): Creates an element: string and number attributes are set, `true` sets an empty attribute, `on*` functions become listeners.

```ts
export function h<K extends keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap>(tag: K, attrs: Attrs = {}, ...children: Child[]): HTMLElementTagNameMap[K];
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createNotice, h } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const answer = h('p', { 'aria-live': 'polite' });

const permission = createNotice({
  kind: 'permission',
  icon: 'microphone',
  title: 'Talk to your home',
  message: 'Allow microphone access to control lights and climate by voice.',
  points: ['Listens only while you hold the button', 'Turn it off any time in Settings'],
  actions: [
    { label: 'Allow microphone', primary: true, onClick: () => (answer.textContent = 'Allowed') },
    { label: 'Not now', dismisses: true, onClick: () => (answer.textContent = 'Asked again later') },
  ],
});

const tip = createNotice({
  kind: 'tip',
  message: 'Long-press a tile to change its size or move it to another room.',
  actions: [{ label: 'Got it', primary: true, dismisses: true }],
});

document.body.append(permission.el, answer, tip.el);
```

## React API

`Notice` (types in `dist/react/feedback.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createNotice`.

```ts
export function Notice({ kind = 'tip', title, children, icon, points, actions, dismissible, dismissLabel = 'Dismiss', onDismiss, headingLevel = 3, className }: NoticeProps);

export interface NoticeProps {
  kind?: NoticeKind;
  title?: ReactNode;
  /** The message. */
  children?: ReactNode;
  icon?: IconName | string | false;
  points?: readonly ReactNode[];
  actions?: readonly NoticeAction[];
  /** A close button; default on for tips. The notice hides itself after `onDismiss`. */
  dismissible?: boolean;
  dismissLabel?: string;
  onDismiss?: () => void;
  headingLevel?: 2 | 3 | 4;
  className?: string;
}
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Notice } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function NoticesExample() {
  const [answer, setAnswer] = useState('');
  return (
    <>
      <Notice
        kind="permission"
        icon="microphone"
        title="Talk to your home"
        points={['Listens only while you hold the button', 'Turn it off any time in Settings']}
        actions={[
          { label: 'Allow microphone', primary: true, onClick: () => setAnswer('Allowed') },
          { label: 'Not now', dismisses: true, onClick: () => setAnswer('Asked again later') },
        ]}
      >
        Allow microphone access to control lights and climate by voice.
      </Notice>
      <p aria-live="polite">{answer}</p>
      <Notice kind="tip" actions={[{ label: 'Got it', primary: true, dismisses: true }]}>
        Long-press a tile to change its size or move it to another room.
      </Notice>
    </>
  );
}
```
